content: We check how different components in the computation of PARENT contribute to its correlation to human judgments. Specifically, we remove the probability INLINEFORM0 of an n-gram INLINEFORM1 being entailed by the table from Eqs. EQREF19 and EQREF23 . The average correlation for PARENT-W drops to INLINEFORM5 in this case. We also try a variant of PARENT with INLINEFORM6 , which removes the contribution of Table Recall (Eq. EQREF22 ). The average correlation is INLINEFORM7 in this case. With these components, the correlation is INLINEFORM8 , showing that they are crucial to the performance of PARENT.
